chunks: And in the narration of Murāzim, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, he said:
"The one performing ʿUmrah Mufradah stops the talbiyah when the camels place their hooves within the Haram."

key_terms.أَخْفَافَهَا: their hooves, marking physical entry into the boundary
key_terms.التَّلْبِيَةَ: the ritual invocation recited during ihram
key_terms.الْإِبِلُ: the camels, used here as the indicator of travel entry
key_terms.الْعُمْرَةِ الْمُفْرَدَةِ: the standalone ʿumrah performed independently of hajj

ai.seo_question: When should a person performing ʿUmrah Mufradah stop reciting the talbiyah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the endpoint of talbiyah for the person performing ʿUmrah Mufradah. It states that the talbiyah is discontinued upon entering the Haram, marked here by the camels placing their hooves within its boundary.
